svg.text: वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि । तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णान्
vāsāṁsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya navāni gṛhṇāti naro ’parāṇi / tathā śarīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇāny a
As a person puts on new garments, giving up old ones, the embodied self similarly accepts new bodies, giving up old ones
KUTUMBA teaching meaning — not labeled as BBT translation
